abstract: Thymic hyperplasia has been reported as a rebound phenomenon in children and young people, most commonly following chemotherapy for cancer. Although thymic hyperplasia has been documented in testis cancer patients after chemotherapy, to our knowledge it has not previously been reported in newly diagnosed cases before systemic therapy. A retrospective review of 362 testicular germ cell tumor patients treated at a single tertiary care center between January 1, 1980 and August 1, 1993 was performed, with special review of 221 who underwent computerized tomography staging of the chest. Thymic hyperplasia was detected in 4 of the 221 patients (1.8%) including 3 of 100 (3.0%) with seminoma and 1 of 121 (0.8%) with nonseminoma. All 4 patients had low stage (I or IIa) disease with a delay in diagnosis (5 to 24 weeks) and thymic hyperplasia was discovered at staging evaluation 18 to 37 days after orchiectomy but before other cancer therapy was administered. Of the 4 patients 2 underwent thymectomy, revealing histological thymic rebound hyperplasia. All 4 patients had no evidence of recurrence at 1 to 54 months after treatment. In addition to the well known post-chemotherapy phenomenon, thymic hyperplasia may also occur in nonsystemically treated, newly diagnosed testicular cancer patients. An anterior mediastinal mass in an otherwise low stage newly diagnosed testicular cancer patient may represent thymic hyperplasia and not necessarily metastatic disease.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の362例を後方視的に検討した。このうち221例でコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による胸部の病期分類が施行され、胸腺過形成は4例（1.8%）に認められた。内訳はセミノーマ3例（100例中3例、3.0%）と非セミノーマ1例（121例中1例、0.8%）であった。全例が低病期（I期またはIIa期）で、診断の遅れは5〜24週間であった。胸腺過形成は精巣摘除術後18〜37日の病期分類評価で発見され、それ以前には他の癌治療は行われていなかった。4例のうち2例で胸腺摘除術が施行され、組織学的に反跳性胸腺過形成が確認された。4例全員が治療後1〜54か月の間に再発を認めなかった。化学療法後の現象として知られている胸腺過形成が、全身療法を受けていない新規診断の精巣がん患者にも生じうる。低病期で新規診断された精巣がん患者に前縦隔の腫瘤を認めた場合、転移性疾患ではなく胸腺過形成である可能性がある。
